subject.title: fix(memory): hide QMD transport metadata from recalled content

question: Should upgrades invalidate the bounded short-term recall cache, or perform source-backed repair of existing rows before this PR closes the linked bug?
rationale: Existing rows lack QMD provenance, making parser-based generic migration unsafe, while leaving them untouched preserves the reported Dreaming contamination after upgrade.

options.title: Invalidate the recall cache
options.body: Treat the bounded recall store as rebuildable transient state and reset it once so all post-upgrade rows use clean adapter output.

options.title: Repair from source text
options.body: Use stored paths and line ranges to reconstruct affected snippets and concept tags, dropping rows that cannot be verified safely.

options.title: Accept residual state
options.body: Land the adapter-only fix but keep a canonical follow-up open that documents the retention window and remaining Dreaming effects.

recommendation.title: Invalidate the recall cache
recommendation.body: Treat the bounded recall store as rebuildable transient state and reset it once so all post-upgrade rows use clean adapter output.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant upgrade choice belongs to the short-term promotion and recall-store feature history this person introduced and expanded.
